Procedure. Then, discard all [ICON: solid white rectangular block].

Reshuffle the Event deck.

Gains 1 Contamination, discard all <ACTION-CARD>, and reshuffle their deck.

Each other <CHARACTER>:
Draw 4<ACTION-CARD> and resolves the Infection Procedure. Then, discards all <ACTION-CARD>.
secondaryEffectDesc: Reshuffle the Event deck.

      'Gains 1 Contamination, discard all <ACTION-CARD>, and reshuffle their deck.',
      'Then, resolve the Eclosion Procedure.',
      'Each other <CHARACTER>:',
